description: Shared view objects the AppView's XRPC methods return. These describe the AppView's canonical DOMAIN entities as served over the wire (the reconciled internal shapes), NOT the public atproto repo records (com.example.wiki.post / .comment / .reaction / .resolution), which are a separate, publish-time shape. Field names are snake_case to match the served JSON. The NSID is a placeholder pending a minted namespace.

authorView.description: An author: a resolved account (a DID), a free-text name with no account (the census found ~42% of author chips are free-text), or a group or event, which is how a branch puts a motion forward. Exactly one of `did`, `display` and `context_id` is present, discriminated by `kind`.

kind.description: `user` when the author is a resolved account, `context` when it is a group or event, `free_text` otherwise.

did.description: The author's DID (present only when `kind` is `user`; during migration this may hold the interim user id until DID binding).

display.description: The free-text author name (present only when `kind` is `free_text`).

context_id.description: The group or event (present only when `kind` is `context`). Written with this alone; it has to be one the caller may read.

name.description: That group's name, when read. Ignored when written.

path.description: That group's path, when read. Ignored when written.

documentView.description: A content node: document / folder / file / proposal, with its authors and its place in the tree.

kind.description: The content sub-kind (open set: unknown values are tolerated for forward compatibility).

slug.description: The URL segment, unique among live siblings. The server picks it from the name.

path.description: The slugs from the root, slash-joined: what the URL carries, and what resolveNode takes.

parent_id.description: The parent node, a context or a document. Absent for a root.

attachable.description: Whether children may be added (the folder lock).

owner_did.description: Who created it. Distinct from authorship.

deleted_at.description: Set while the node is in the bin. No read but the bin's own serves such a node.

deleted_root.description: The node whose deletion took this one to the bin: itself, or an ancestor.

mutable.description: Whether it may still be edited. Submitting a motion clears it.

data.description: What the node holds beside its text: a file's id and type, a cover image. An object, or absent.

content.description: The Slate document JSON, carried verbatim (parsed only at the publish seam). Absent for content-free nodes (folders).

authors.description: Zero or more authors (the census found up to 8 per node), each a DID or a free-text fallback.

visibility.description: `public` content is mirrored to a repo; `private` stays AppView-only.

published_uri.description: The at-uri of the mirrored public record, when published.

legacy_id.description: The interim node id this row was migrated from (import provenance).

contextView.description: A context: a group, an event or a site, the org's organizing structure, with its place in the tree.

slug.description: The URL segment, unique among live siblings. The server picks it from the name.

path.description: The slugs from the root, slash-joined: what the URL carries, and what resolveNode takes.

parent_id.description: The parent node, a context or a document. Absent for a root.

attachable.description: Whether children may be added (the folder lock).

owner_did.description: Who created it. Distinct from authorship.

deleted_at.description: Set while the node is in the bin. No read but the bin's own serves such a node.

deleted_root.description: The node whose deletion took this one to the bin: itself, or an ancestor.

commentView.description: An internal threaded comment on a document or another comment.

on_id.description: The document or comment this replies to.

reactionView.description: An emoji reaction to a subject, addressed by the subject's at-uri.

id.description: The reaction record's at-uri (its primary key).

subject_uri.description: The at-uri of the record being reacted to.

reactor_did.description: The reactor's DID (absent only for a not-yet-realized user).

memberView.description: A row of a context's member list: a member, or an invitation nobody has claimed yet.

user_did.description: Absent while the row is an invitation nobody has claimed.

active.description: Voting rights, which an owner grants. Not membership.

accepted.description: Whether they have said yes to the invitation.

hidden.description: Kept off the list everyone sees. Only an owner is served such a row.

name.description: The roster's name for them: the only label an unclaimed invitation has.

email.description: Present only when the caller owns the context.

userView.description: A person. The DID is the identity; the rest is profile, absent until it has been read from their PDS.

blobView.description: A stored file. `id` is what a node refers to; the bytes are at `GET /blob/<id>`.

context_id.description: The context whose readers may read the file.

owner_did.description: Whoever uploaded it. Absent on a file migrated from an account that was never claimed.

mime.description: As the uploader declared it, reduced to `type/subtype`.

pollView.description: A poll as one caller may see it. It is also a node of kind `poll`, at `path`.

question.description: The wording voted on. Fixed when the poll opened; renaming the node does not change it.

blank.description: The last option is the abstention.

issuer_pubkey.description: A secret poll's RSA key as SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER, base64url without padding. PROVISIONAL with the other ballot encodings (`crates/ballot-spec` DECISIONS.md D7).

ballots.description: Ballots cast so far, by weight. Shown to everyone: a room reads its turnout off this.

eligible.description: The sum of the weights frozen at opening: what `ballots` is out of. 0 for a poll carried over from the interim, which froze no roster, so there a turnout cannot be shown.

counts.description: One count per option. Absent where the tally is hidden from the caller.

outcome.description: Absent with `counts`. The abstention never wins; options sharing the top count are a tie.

viewer.description: The caller's standing in the poll. Absent for someone who held no voting rights when it opened.

weight.description: Ballots the caller has. 0 when their weight went to a delegate.

issued.description: A secret poll: the caller has collected their tokens. Whether they then cast them the server cannot know.

choices.description: An open poll: the caller's own ballot, once cast.

nodeRef.description: Enough of a node to name it and link to it.

title.description: A document's title, or a context's name.

hitView.description: A search hit: a `nodeRef`, with where it was found and where it sits.

matched.description: `title` when every word is in what it is called.

parent.description: Where it sits, if the caller may read that too.

feedItemView.description: One thing that happened. Light on purpose: it never carries a document's content.

kind.description: A document's kind; `comment` for a comment.

text.description: A document's title, or a comment's text.

path.description: A document's own path. A comment is reached through `about`.

by_text.description: A comment by someone with no account.

about.description: Where a document sits, or what a comment is on, if the caller may read it.

feedbackView.description: A report: a person's account, or a crash folded from every time it was seen.

message.description: With its stack resolved. Of a folded crash, the first sighting's.

seen.description: How often a folded crash has been reported. 1 for anything else.

reporters.description: Everyone who has hit a folded crash: DIDs, and `anonymous` at most once for all of those with no account.

owner_did.description: Whoever sent it first. Absent when they were not signed in.

boardEntryView.description: One spent token on a secret poll's board. It carries no voter, by construction. PROVISIONAL encoding (`crates/ballot-spec/src/provisional.rs`).
